android.desc:
🧩Padaku: Guess the mystery word in 6 tries! Colorful tiles guide each attempt, revealing which letters are in the right spot, which are misplaced, and which aren’t in today's word.

🐝 Pagoodu: How many words can you create? Build as many words as possible from a 7-letter honeycomb, always using the center letter.

🧵 Padanoolu: Weave your way through themed word paths! Connect letters across the board to discover the hidden words, or craft your own custom puzzles.

🔗 Sarapali: Connect letters around the square to forge a chain of words! Each new word picks up from the last letter of the previous one. Can you use every letter in the fewest words possible?
